# spaceman task

The execution queue: list, show, create, reorder and update tasks (--space).

Aliases: `tasks`, `queue`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman task create`](#spaceman-task-create) | Add a task to the queue |
| [`spaceman task get`](#spaceman-task-get) | Show a task |
| [`spaceman task list`](#spaceman-task-list) | The space's queue in order, with its policy |
| [`spaceman task move`](#spaceman-task-move) | Reorder a task: --top, --bottom, --before or --after |
| [`spaceman task next`](#spaceman-task-next) | The task the queue would start next, and why |
| [`spaceman task set-status`](#spaceman-task-set-status) | Change a task's status |
| [`spaceman task update`](#spaceman-task-update) | Edit a task (only the flags given change) |

## spaceman task create

Add a task to the queue.

```sh
spaceman task create [flags]
```

API: `create-task` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--acceptance` | string |  | acceptance criteria |
| `--acceptance-file` | string |  | read --acceptance from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `--depends-on` | string, repeatable |  | task it depends on (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--exclusion` | string, repeatable |  | exclusion (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--from-inbox` | string |  | inbox item the task comes from |
| `--idempotency-key` | string |  | Idempotency-Key to send (default: a fresh random key); reuse it to retry this create safely |
| `--kind` | string |  | ordinary (default) or incident |
| `--objective` | string |  | what the task should achieve |
| `--objective-file` | string |  | read --objective from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `--parent` | string |  | parent task ID |
| `--priority` | string |  | low, normal, high or urgent |
| `--role` | string |  | role that should work on it |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
| `--status` | string |  | backlog or ready (default) |
| `--title` | string |  | title (required) |
| `--workspace` | string |  | workspace |

## spaceman task move

Reorder a task: --top, --bottom, --before or --after.

```sh
spaceman task move <task> [flags]
```

API: `move-task` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--after` | string |  | place it after this task |
| `--before` | string |  | place it before this task |
| `--bottom` | bool |  | move it to the bottom |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
| `--top` | bool |  | move it to the top |

## spaceman task set-status

Change a task's status.

```sh
spaceman task set-status <task> <status> [flags]
```

API: `get-task`, `set-task-status` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--reason` | string |  | reason |
| `--result` | string |  | result summary |
| `--result-file` | string |  | read --result from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
